title: Capybara Wins Overtime From Half Court Without Running 🏀
description:
Kapi never ran, so he's the only one with any energy left in overtime. 🏀😴 One lazy toss from half court, and Season 1 is a wrap.

Kapi in the League, Episode 5: Overtime. A 3D animated basketball comedy about a very calm capybara, a very big bear (Bruno) and a very fast rabbit (Bunny), with Rico the parrot on the mic.

▶️ Start from Episode 1, Season Opener: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ULDSAqNZm8g
👉 Season 2 is coming. Subscribe to Kapi's World so you don't miss it!
💬 Season 1 is done! Which episode was your favourite, 1 to 5? Tell us in the comments!

Made with AI-assisted animation tools. The characters and the story are original.
